title: GRPO: Group Rewards, One Clear Update

articles.title: GRPO: Group Rewards, One Clear Update
articles.description: A compact, visual path through Group Relative Policy Optimization: why groups replace the critic, how PPO's guardrail remains, and where the method can fail.

articles.title: Turn a Group into an Advantage
articles.description: Compute group-relative advantages by hand and see why disagreement between sampled completions creates the learning signal.

articles.title: Keep the PPO Guardrail
articles.description: See how GRPO inserts group-relative advantages into PPO's clipped ratio objective and keeps a reference-model anchor for language-model training.

articles.title: When a Group Says Nothing
articles.description: Learn the practical failure modes of GRPO: zero-variance groups, prompt difficulty, reward scale, sequence length, and verifier errors.

articles.title: From Equation to Experiment
articles.description: A practical GRPO checklist: freeze the right policies, compute group advantages once, log the evidence, and choose between PPO, GRPO, and DPO.
